result.summary: The environment is a wide, multi-lane arterial with a large grassy median separating traffic flows. While a marked crosswalk and traffic signals are present, the scale of the roadway and the significant distance pedestrians must cover suggest a high-speed, car-oriented design that is hostile to walking.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of a wide boulevard, increasing exposure time to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide lanes and open design of the boulevard encourage high vehicle speeds in a residential context.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island Enhancements
interventions.description: Improve the existing median with paved waiting areas and protective bollards to provide a safer mid-point for long crossings.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow vehicle speeds and shorten crossing distances.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with significant pedestrian exposure and minimal crossing infrastructure across the main thoroughfare. While a marked crosswalk exists for a side street, the primary roadway lacks visible pedestrian signals or markings, prioritizing high-volume vehicle flow.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The main roadway is very wide with multiple lanes, requiring pedestrians to cross a long distance without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible across the primary multi-lane road, increasing risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings across all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features multi-lane traffic with a grass median and marked zebra crosswalks. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and a small refuge island exist, the wide roadway and poor pavement quality on pedestrian paths create a challenging environment for walkers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center-right.

hazards.name: Degraded Pedestrian Surface
hazards.description: The concrete island and surrounding pavement are cracked and uneven, posing a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: The refuge island in the middle of the crossing.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, particularly near the slip lane area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Refuge Island Upgrade
interventions.description: Reconstruct and enlarge the pedestrian refuge island with better pavement and ADA-compliant features.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals to provide pedestrians with information on remaining crossing time.
